differences.detail: The repo's dispatch rejects this model id: argparse choices do not include it and get_model only matches 'qwen-2.5' (case-sensitive, hyphenated) before raising ValueError. Its Qwen2 code (qwen_utils.get_qwen2 / apply_flatquant_to_qwen, written for the transformers 4.45 class names) fits this model; call it directly instead of the name check.

The packed int4 path (--quantized_save, pack_i4, deploy/ kernels, FlatQuantLlamaForCausalLM) exists only for Llama. A Qwen2 port needs: a packed save of all 7 decoder linears (int4 weights with fp16 scales) plus the online transforms (qkv/up-gate/down Kronecker, P_h, P_o^T) and the fused norms; an inference adapter that rebuilds Qwen2 with those packed linears, restores eval-only flags (_eval_mode, use_diag) after load, does not re-fuse packed weights, casts kernel-facing scales to fp16 after load, and re-ties lm_head.

The packed path's Triton block_matmul uses tl.arange over num_heads; Qwen2.5-1.5B has 12 query heads (not a power of two), so the o_proj input transform kernel likely fails to compile. Use the torch kron path or pad for that transform. Kronecker factors (32,48) and (80,112) are not powers of two either; check the kron kernel handles them.

q/k/v have biases. The input-side transform leaves all three biases valid; the output-side per-head P_v is applied to the v bias as well as the v weight in training and fold; P_h is applied online after RoPE and never folded, so q/k biases stay as they are. No patch needed; the packed save must carry the transformed v bias.
Nothing is fused into embed_tokens or lm_head, so the tie holds. A packed save built from named_parameters() drops the tied lm_head; the reload must re-tie it (vllm_custom/qwen2_flatquant.py does).
KV4 asymmetric quant with learned clipping (LAC) in fake quant; the packed KV cache ignores the learned clipping. Keep the learned KV clipping in the reload path, or note the gap in the overlay.
No num_kv_heads == num_heads assumption; P_h/P_v are head_dim x head_dim (128), P_o spans the 12 query heads.

Calibration and training as the repo's Qwen-2.5 scripts: W4 per-channel sym, A4 per-token sym, KV4 asym, wikitext2 128 x 2048, 15 epochs, flat_lr 5e-3, --lwc --lac --cali_trans --add_diag --deactive_amp --direct_inv, transformers 4.45.0. Calibration data must be provided locally (no Hub downloads during jobs). --direct_inv leaves InvSingleTransMatrix.linear modules that RTN quantizes spuriously; keep them out of the saved artifact.

deploy.sym_dequant computes int_to_half(acc/10.0f)*10 with a static_cast<int>, truncating the int32 GEMM accumulator to a multiple of 10 (acc 29 -> 20): about 3% error per projection on the packed path, Llama included. Dequantize the exact int32 accumulator (scale in fp32) instead of calling that kernel, or fix the kernel in the overlay.

D4 holds for the function, but the k_proj bias dominates the per-token KV4 key range: up to 316 (layer 0) and 101 (layer 1) against a token-dependent std of about 1.5 after RoPE, so a 4-bit asymmetric step (~37) erases the key signal until the learned P_h and K clip have trained for about 200+ optimizer steps per layer. Smoke must calibrate with enough steps; at the full recipe KV4 still costs (2-layer W4A4 0.129 vs W4A4KV4 0.165). Bias-aware K quantization (quantize only the token-dependent part, add RoPE(b_k) back in full precision) would change the method's quantizer and is not applied.
evidence: qwen2_packed_torch worker probe: k bias absmax 316/101, K4-only attention error 1.03/0.56

notes: Recipe lookup returned nothing: the only FlatQuant row is microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct (model_type phi3, packed, PPL ratio 1.168 on A10G, same repo commit) and its port was not stored. target_regex limits coverage to the 7 decoder projections because FlatQuant's transform matrices (InvSingleTransMatrix.linear and friends) stay in fp16 by design and must not count as unquantized targets.
